artifact_layout.race_mapping: observations/{race_id}.parquet, one atomic file per race
artifact_layout.rationale: outside data/v2 so the frozen D11 artifact-inventory scope is untouched; outside runtime bundle manifests; per-race files for atomic resume

availability.helper: classify_availability (pure; rejects negative and non-finite ages)

coordinate_semantics.normalization: deferred to P12-3; raw preserved here

duplicate_semantics.conflicting: same (driver, Time, Date) with differing coordinates: fail closed (SpatialDuplicateConflictError); zero observed
duplicate_semantics.exact: same (driver, Time), identical payload: removed by keep-last rule
duplicate_semantics.resolution: keep-last-by-source-time within (driver_number, observation_time_s) ordered by transient source_observed_at
duplicate_semantics.sub_timestamp: same Time buckets differ only by sub-second Date order (0 same-Date conflicts observed)

fixture_inventory: tiny synthetic builders local to each test file (no fixture files, no real telemetry committed)

identity.display: driver_id slug and abbreviation are display only, never identity
identity.driver_number: int 1-99 (canonicalized from FastF1 string keys at ingestion)
identity.mapping: corpus driver_number matches position-stream keys; race_id frozen season-rRR-R form

logical_content_hash.method: sha256 over canonical JSON (sort_keys, compact separators, NaN rejected)
logical_content_hash.promise: same logical dataset hashes identically; byte-identical Parquet across library versions NOT promised

statuses.COMPLETE: full expected driver set present, artifact validates
statuses.PARTIAL: source present but incomplete, reason recorded

missingness.coordinate_invalid: rejected, never persisted with nulls (zero-fix sentinel excluded at ingestion)
missingness.retirement: RaceState status truth, never inferred from coordinates; spatial layer reports coordinate availability only
missingness.session_interrupted: session status stream owns truth; spatial rows remain factual observations

must: load FastF1 position source via cache-first session load
write one atomic parquet per race (snappy, pyarrow, no index)

predictive_firewall.allowed_direction: historical source -> raceintel.spatial -> replay/API/frontend (later); never spatial -> predictive stack
predictive_firewall.enforcement: import-direction source-scan tests both ways; product-season drift test vs api/v2_service

served_firewall.mechanism: is_product_servable plus PRODUCT_SERVED_SEASONS drift-guarded against api.v2_service.SERVED_SEASONS (no raceintel->api import)

source_preservation: deterministic cleaned representation: raw cache untouched; exact duplicates and zero-fix sentinels removed; everything else preserved bit-for-bit (no resampling or smoothing)

test_inventory.tests/test_spatial_firewall.py: import-direction scans, season authority, ALL_84 unchanged

time_semantics.basis: FastF1 session clock, identical to replay anchor_state_time_s (measured ~0.1s agreement, no offset)
time_semantics.causal_rule: P12-4 may only select observation_time_s <= T; no nearest-neighbor, no future interpolation
